apply_rules: Apply in the listed order on the RAW content (context=edit). Every "old" matches content.rendered exactly once at its turn (matches_in_live), except "replace_all" entries, which match exactly "expect_matches" times.

Edits with "spans_tags": true replace a whole <table> element: if "old" does not match the raw content exactly (raw line breaks between tags can differ), locate the single <table> element that contains "anchor" and replace that element with "new".

Every other old string sits inside one paragraph, list item or table cell and holds no HTML entity. The rendered content shows straight quotes (ש"ח, מ"ר) and no texturized characters, so raw and rendered text are expected to be identical inside a paragraph; re-check each old against the raw content right before applying.

tier 1 = sale-price alignment with the official list (conflicts, stale and unsourced sale figures); tier 2 = rent or other figures with no dated source. Applying tier 1 alone is valid (tier 2 olds do not overlap tier 1 results).
All or nothing per page: if any old does not match, write nothing. Re-fetch the page first; another session may have edited it. Data only: nothing here was applied.

Tier 2 under the CEO rule (7.10.2026): apply AFTER tier 1 (tier 1 is already live on this page), on the live content, in the listed order. Each tier-2 edit carries ceo_action (replaced = an official dated value now stands there, with its source_url; removed = number gone, sentence or cell kept; deleted = sentence, row or column gone) and ceo_note.
notes: Not audited as claims (illustrations and method numbers, not market statements): the 8-12 m2 / one-vs-two parking example (p@46975), the 10 m2 x 28,000 = 280,000 arithmetic example (p@56855), the comparison counts 10-15 / 4-8 deals (p@57112), the steps table working numbers including 'פער סביר יכול להיות 5%-15%' between comparables (tr@62678..63791), the 100,000-300,000 negotiation illustration (p@64623) and the 10-20 listings / 6-10 deals counts (p@67326). Per-m2 figures are kept only where the page ties them to its own dated public market check ('בדיקת שוק גלויה מ-6 ביוני 2026', usage note p@42858, and rows marked 'בהקשרים שנבדקו' / 'לפי הקשר שוק' / 'בדיקות שוק הצביעו'); the kind of source is generic, so this keep is borderline and can be revisited. The neighbourhood per-m2 table (12 of 14 rows unlabelled) is replaced by official neighbourhood medians. The Mahane Yehuda per-m2 range 20,000-24,000 comes from the same check whose 3-room range (1.5-1.9M) sits below the official 1,951,200; it is kept as labelled but is the weakest kept figure. Name mapping: page 'כפר גנים א'' / 'כפר גנים ב'' = official 'כפר גנים א' / 'כפר גנים ב'. The official 'הדר המושבות החדשה' is NOT mapped to the page's 'אם המושבות החדשה' (different names; shown as 'לא מוצג במחירון'); the official 'נווה עוז הירוקה' appears only in the 5-room FAQ. The remaining SUSPECT on p@42022 is a floor/ceiling span (1.5M for small old flats up to 4.2M for 5 rooms, new flats and demanded areas) that holds the official 5-room median 3,322,600; it is a heuristic false positive, kept as CONSISTENT. Official quirk: none sharp; 4 rooms moved 2,565,500 (10-12.2025) to 2,444,100 (1-3.2026).
